Indexed specification:
{"S01":"You are to design a one-input one-output serial 2's complementer Moore state machine.","S02":"The input (x) is a series of bits (one per clock cycle) beginning with the least-significant bit of the number, and the output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input.","S03":"The machine will accept input numbers of arbitrary length.","S04":"The circuit requires a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset.","S05":"The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted."}

{"ports":{"inputs":{"areset":1,"x":1},"outputs":{"z":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"A","meaning":"Reset state; carry=0, no input 1 has yet been seen, and Moore output z=0.","update_time":"asynchronously to A when areset=1; otherwise on posedge clk when areset=0","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"B","meaning":"carry=1, at least one input 1 has been seen, and Moore output z=1.","update_time":"posedge clk when areset=0","update_during_reset":false},{"name":"C","meaning":"carry=1, at least one input 1 has been seen, and Moore output z=0.","update_time":"posedge clk when areset=0","update_during_reset":false}],"rules":[{"id":"async_reset","outputs":["z"],"condition":"areset is asserted high; asynchronous reset forces state A and z=0 independent of clk.","edge":"asynchronous","visible":"same_cycle","priority":0,"spec_quote":"asynchronous reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"areset":1,"x":0},{"areset":1,"x":1}],"expected":[{"z":0},{"z":0}]}},{"id":"serial_twos_complement","outputs":["z"],"condition":"areset=0; on posedge clk sample x and update the Moore state. From A: x=0 -> A/z=0, x=1 -> B/z=1. From B: x=0 -> B/z=1, x=1 -> C/z=0. From C: x=0 -> B/z=1, x=1 -> C/z=0. The output z is the state output after the settled posedge, implementing LSB-first two's complement: copy x until the first 1, then invert subsequent bits.","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"beginning with the least-significant bit of the number, and the output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"areset":0,"x":0},{"areset":0,"x":1},{"areset":0,"x":1},{"areset":0,"x":0}],"expected":[{"z":0},{"z":1},{"z":0},{"z":1}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"async","name":"areset","active":"high","values":{"z":0},"first_released_cycle":"first posedge clk after areset returns to 0; the first x bit is sampled on that active edge"},"mid":"mid changes occur after the sampled posedge, do not affect the current row's expected outputs, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
